description: A long, luminous gallery hallway with a calm, editorial character. The ceiling is clad in horizontal light oak wood planks in a warm blonde tone, providing a warm natural canopy. The walls are smooth matte white plaster. The floor is large-format pale limestone or travertine tiles. On the right side, two dark-stained reclaimed wood benches with visible rough sawn textures sit against the wall — the nearest very close to camera, the second further along the passage. Above the benches hang a series of framed botanical or abstract prints in simple light oak frames, matted and evenly spaced as a gallery wall. Further along the passage, a large potted fiddle-leaf fig in a woven wicker planter anchors the terminus. Two patterned vintage-style wool runners in muted dusty blue, cream, and warm tan lay along the floor in sequence, leading the eye toward the distant end. A warm soft glow descends from the ceiling in the foreground and middle zones, adding a gentle illuminated quality to the wood ceiling above.
